## Checklist

- [ ] The title is a Conventional Commit (`feat: …`, `fix: …`, `docs: …`).
- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] New behavior has a test.
- [ ] UI changes work on a phone width and in both themes; screenshots are rendered again if a README screen changed.
- [ ] The README and `OVERVIEW.md` describe any change people will notice.
